src.name: 枣面
src.effect: 所有干员受到来自自身阻挡单位的伤害降低50％，对被自身阻挡的敌人造成的伤害提高50%
src.flavor: 一位古代大炎英雄的脸谱。有记载称其忠心不二，为保结义金兰，千里一骑力克千军。

rogue_5_relic_blockg_1.name: Jujube Mask
rogue_5_relic_blockg_1.effect: All Operators take 50% less damage from units they are blocking, and deal 50% more damage to enemies they are blocking
rogue_5_relic_blockg_1.flavor: The opera mask of an ancient hero of Great Yan. Records say he was loyal without wavering, and to protect his sworn brothers rode alone a thousand miles, overcoming an army of thousands.

src.name: 老者面
src.effect: 所有干员每秒对自身阻挡的敌人造成攻击力150%的法术伤害并减低目标15%的命中率
src.flavor: 一位上古大炎英雄的脸谱。天师一词的源流，传说其博学多闻，为炎氏谋千载太平后消失无踪。

rogue_5_relic_blockg_2.name: Elder's Mask
rogue_5_relic_blockg_2.effect: Every second, all Operators deal Arts Damage equal to 150% of their ATK to enemies they are blocking and reduce the target's accuracy by 15%
rogue_5_relic_blockg_2.flavor: The opera mask of a hero of high antiquity in Great Yan, the origin of the word "Tianshi". Legend says he was learned and wise, and vanished after securing a thousand years of peace for the Yan.

src.name: 炭面
src.effect: 敌人首次被阻挡时，恐惧5秒
src.flavor: 一位古代大炎英雄的脸谱。有记载称其胆大心细，喝声可断江河。

rogue_5_relic_blockg_3.name: Charcoal Mask
rogue_5_relic_blockg_3.effect: Enemies are inflicted with Fear for 5 seconds the first time they are blocked
rogue_5_relic_blockg_3.flavor: The opera mask of an ancient hero of Great Yan. Records say he was bold yet meticulous, and his shout could split rivers.

src.name: 月女面
src.effect: 干员每阻挡一名敌人，获得10%物理与法术闪避，最多叠加5层
src.flavor: 一位传说中的大炎人物的脸谱。其为寻夫泪洒成河飞身逐月的故事流传至今。

rogue_5_relic_blockg_4.name: Moon Maiden Mask
rogue_5_relic_blockg_4.effect: For each enemy an Operator blocks, they gain 10% Physical and Arts Dodge (stacks up to 5 times)
rogue_5_relic_blockg_4.flavor: The opera mask of a legendary figure of Great Yan. The tale of her tears flowing into a river as she searched for her husband, and of her flight to chase the moon, is still told today.

src.name: 鸣镝吹筒
src.effect: 干员损失30%的生命值时，对攻击范围内的所有敌人造成一次10秒的恐惧
src.flavor: 用于发讯与示警的吹箭筒，若是沾了血，鸣镝发射时啸叫声震耳欲聋，凄烈无比，令人下意识想要逃离。

rogue_5_relic_blockg_5.name: Whistling Arrow Blowpipe
rogue_5_relic_blockg_5.effect: When an Operator loses 30% of their HP, inflict Fear on all enemies within their attack range for 10 seconds
rogue_5_relic_blockg_5.flavor: A blowpipe for signals and warnings. Stained with blood, its whistling arrow shrieks so piercingly and so mournfully on release that listeners instinctively want to flee.

src.name: 传芳雕版
src.effect: 干员开启弹药类技能后，每次造成伤害时，攻击力+2%（最多叠加30层）
src.flavor: 流行诗集的枣木雕版。见到自己眼中欠佳的俗诗雕版广为流传时，清高文人往往嗤之以鼻：“哼，可悲枣树，罪不至此。”

rogue_5_relic_bullet_1.name: Chuanfang Printing Block
rogue_5_relic_bullet_1.effect: After an Operator activates an ammo-based skill, gain +2% ATK each time they deal damage (stacks up to 30 times)
rogue_5_relic_bullet_1.flavor: A jujube-wood printing block for a popular poetry collection. When proud literati saw such vulgar verse spread far and wide, they would sneer: "Hmph. Poor jujube tree, it did nothing to deserve this."

src.name: 三尺万象
src.effect: 干员开启弹药类技能时，攻击速度+100，持续15秒
src.flavor: 古时炎国印书坊所用活字印刷机。君子以字为利器，而小人......曾有印书坊下印前，发现“非”字被偷，驳斥之文意思骤变，令人啼笑皆非。

rogue_5_relic_bullet_2.name: Three Feet of Myriad Forms
rogue_5_relic_bullet_2.effect: When an Operator activates an ammo-based skill, gain +100 ASPD for 15 seconds
rogue_5_relic_bullet_2.flavor: A movable-type press from an ancient Yan print shop. The gentleman wields words as weapons, while the petty... Once, before a print run, a shop found the character for "not" had been stolen, and a rebuttal suddenly meant the opposite, to everyone's mixed amusement.

src.name: 《炎国字汇》
src.effect: 弹药类技能每次开启后，首次剩余30%的弹药时，补充最大弹药数量30%的弹药
src.flavor: 炎国的第一本通用字典，由民间作者历经十年完成。编者常叹书薄而字多，为无法收录、注定失传的生僻字立有一方字冢。

rogue_5_relic_bullet_3.name: "Yan Lexicon"
rogue_5_relic_bullet_3.effect: Each time an ammo-based skill is activated, the first time ammo drops to 30%, replenish ammo equal to 30% of the maximum
rogue_5_relic_bullet_3.flavor: Yan's first general dictionary, completed by a commoner author over ten years. The compiler often lamented that the book was thin and the characters many, and raised a tomb for the rare characters he could not include, destined to be lost.

src.name: 《雅集》
src.effect: 弹药类技能每次开启后，首次剩余30%的弹药时，补充最大弹药数量50%的弹药
src.flavor: 炎国的第一部诗集，收录了当年传唱最广的诗篇。因其广受欢迎，促使民间抄诗与写诗的热情剧增，一度导致当年的纸墨供不应求。

rogue_5_relic_bullet_4.name: "Elegant Gathering"
rogue_5_relic_bullet_4.effect: Each time an ammo-based skill is activated, the first time ammo drops to 30%, replenish ammo equal to 50% of the maximum
rogue_5_relic_bullet_4.flavor: Yan's first poetry anthology, collecting the most widely sung poems of its day. Its popularity sparked such a craze for copying and writing poems that paper and ink were in short supply that year.

src.name: 四方绘料
src.effect: 每场战斗仅一次，已部署4名干员时，下一名部署的干员获得生命值+50%，防御力+50%，阻挡数+5
src.flavor: 夕亲自调制，世所罕见的颜料，同时也是她的印信。蘸染时，四色置单景。

rogue_5_relic_cardg_1.name: Four-Quarter Pigments
rogue_5_relic_cardg_1.effect: Once per battle, when 4 Operators are deployed, the next Operator deployed gains +50% Max HP, +50% DEF, and +5 Block
rogue_5_relic_cardg_1.flavor: Pigments mixed by Dusk herself, rarely seen in this world, and also her seal. Dip the brush, and four colors settle into a single scene.

src.name: 四时丹青毫
src.effect: 每场战斗仅一次，已部署4名干员时，下一名部署的干员获得抵抗，攻击力+50%，受到的元素损伤降低50%
src.flavor: 夕亲自制作，世所罕见的毛笔，同时也是她的印信。下笔时，四时恒如一。

rogue_5_relic_cardg_2.name: Four-Seasons Painting Brush
rogue_5_relic_cardg_2.effect: Once per battle, when 4 Operators are deployed, the next Operator deployed gains Resistance, +50% ATK, and takes 50% less Elemental Injury
rogue_5_relic_cardg_2.flavor: A brush made by Dusk herself, rarely seen in this world, and also her seal. Put brush to paper, and the four seasons are forever as one.

src.name: 士影
src.effect: 每次部署待部署区最右侧的干员时，使全场干员获得消耗费用一定比例的屏障
src.flavor: 为纪念一位守城将士而制的皮影。传闻其在边防战中带数名士兵守城百日，城破之时，其屹立城头，随之没入黄沙。玉门城建成后，曾为其立像纪念。
src.unlock: 携带不小于3名重装干员完成一场战斗

rogue_5_relic_cardg_3.name: Soldier's Shadow
rogue_5_relic_cardg_3.effect: Each time the rightmost Operator in the deployment area is deployed, all Operators on the field gain a Barrier equal to a portion of the DP spent
rogue_5_relic_cardg_3.flavor: A shadow puppet made in memory of a soldier who defended a city. Legend says he held it for a hundred days with a handful of men during a border war; when the city fell, he stood tall atop the wall and was swallowed by the yellow sands with it. After Yumen was built, a statue was raised in his memory.
rogue_5_relic_cardg_3.unlock: Complete a battle while having at least 3 Defender Operators

src.name: 匠影
src.effect: 每次部署待部署区最左侧的干员时，使全场干员获得消耗费用100%的技力
src.flavor: 为纪念一位巧手者而制的皮影。其一生追求技艺之极致。歹人垂涎其技，而其不为金钱所惑，亦不为皮肉苦所动，只望其技不染。后殁于贼穴，其著作亦付之一炬，未传后人。
src.unlock: 携带不小于3名辅助干员完成一场战斗

rogue_5_relic_cardg_4.name: Artisan's Shadow
rogue_5_relic_cardg_4.effect: Each time the leftmost Operator in the deployment area is deployed, all Operators on the field gain SP equal to 100% of the DP spent
rogue_5_relic_cardg_4.flavor: A shadow puppet made in memory of a master craftsman who pursued perfection in their craft all their life. Villains coveted that skill, but the artisan was swayed by neither money nor torture, wishing only that the craft remain unsullied. They died in a bandits' den, and their writings were burned, never passed on.
rogue_5_relic_cardg_4.unlock: Complete a battle while having at least 3 Supporter Operators

src.name: 艺影
src.effect: 进入战斗时，待部署区最左侧的干员初始技力+10，攻击速度+30，攻击力+30%
src.flavor: 为纪念一位传奇舞者而制的皮影。传闻其舞于大江，舞出巨浪之势；舞于林间，舞出春芽之美。其一生为舞，年老后受伤隐退，不久便撒手人寰。无数舞者仿其姿而不得其意，可惜可叹。

rogue_5_relic_cardg_5.name: Performer's Shadow
rogue_5_relic_cardg_5.effect: On entering battle, the leftmost Operator in the deployment area gains +10 Starting SP, +30 ASPD, and +30% ATK
rogue_5_relic_cardg_5.flavor: A shadow puppet made in memory of a legendary dancer. Legend says that dancing by the great river, she conjured the might of towering waves; dancing in the woods, the beauty of spring buds. She lived for dance, retired after an injury in old age, and soon passed away. Countless dancers have copied her poses without capturing their spirit, to everyone's regret.

src.name: 商影
src.effect: 进入战斗时，待部署区最右侧的干员阻挡数+2，防御力+50%，最大生命值+50%，部署后返回50%的部署费用
src.flavor: 为纪念一位多财善贾之商人而制的皮影。其曾召集一支民间车队，穿梭于天灾高发地带，于城乡间买卖，缓物资之急。待城间驰道最终修成之时，却故于意外。

rogue_5_relic_cardg_6.name: Merchant's Shadow
rogue_5_relic_cardg_6.effect: On entering battle, the rightmost Operator in the deployment area gains +2 Block, +50% DEF, and +50% Max HP, and refunds 50% of their DP Cost after deployment
rogue_5_relic_cardg_6.flavor: A shadow puppet made in memory of a wealthy, shrewd merchant who once gathered a civilian caravan to cross catastrophe-prone lands, trading between city and countryside to ease shortages. Just as the highway between the cities was finally completed, he died in an accident.

src.name: “摘衡”
src.effect: 所有【近战】干员，生命值+35%，攻击力+35%
src.flavor: 双符相合，故人昔事几何？

rogue_5_relic_custog_1.name: "Plucked Balance"
rogue_5_relic_custog_1.effect: All [Melee] Operators gain +35% Max HP and +35% ATK
rogue_5_relic_custog_1.flavor: Two talismans joined as one; how much of the old friends' past remains?

src.name: “岁衡”
src.effect: 【伺烛客】的攻击力+50%，防御力+50%
src.flavor: 双符相合，故人昔事几何？

rogue_5_relic_custog_10.name: "Sui's Balance"
rogue_5_relic_custog_10.flavor: Two talismans joined as one; how much of the old friends' past remains?

src.name: “岁花”
src.effect: 所有干员的部署费用+3，编队中每有一名【伺烛客】，则【伺烛客】的生命值，攻击力，防御力+10%
src.flavor: 双符相合，故人昔事几何？

rogue_5_relic_custog_11.name: "Sui's Flower"
rogue_5_relic_custog_11.effect: All Operators have +3 DP Cost; for each [Candle Attendant] in the squad, [Candle Attendants] gain +10% Max HP, ATK, and DEF
rogue_5_relic_custog_11.flavor: Two talismans joined as one; how much of the old friends' past remains?

src.name: “岁厉”
src.effect: 【伺烛客】部署后10秒内攻击力+100%，每有干员通过作战成为【伺烛客】时，持续时间+5秒(最多提升15次)
src.flavor: 双符相合，故人昔事几何？

rogue_5_relic_custog_12.name: "Sui's Ferocity"
rogue_5_relic_custog_12.effect: [Candle Attendants] gain +100% ATK for 10 seconds after deployment; each time an Operator becomes a [Candle Attendant] through an operation, the duration is extended by 5 seconds (up to 15 times)
rogue_5_relic_custog_12.flavor: Two talismans joined as one; how much of the old friends' past remains?

src.name: “摘花”
src.effect: 所有【近战】干员，部署费用+3，阻挡数+1，防御力+50%
src.flavor: 双符相合，故人昔事几何？

rogue_5_relic_custog_2.name: "Plucked Flower"
rogue_5_relic_custog_2.effect: All [Melee] Operators have +3 DP Cost, +1 Block, and +50% DEF
rogue_5_relic_custog_2.flavor: Two talismans joined as one; how much of the old friends' past remains?

src.name: “摘厉”
src.effect: 所有【近战】干员部署后每秒恢复相当于最大生命值5%的生命值，持续20秒
src.flavor: 双符相合，故人昔事几何？

rogue_5_relic_custog_3.name: "Plucked Ferocity"
rogue_5_relic_custog_3.effect: All [Melee] Operators restore HP equal to 5% of their Max HP per second for 20 seconds after deployment
rogue_5_relic_custog_3.flavor: Two talismans joined as one; how much of the old friends' past remains?

src.name: “掷衡”
src.effect: 所有【远程】干员，生命值+25%，攻击力+25%
src.flavor: 双符相合，故人昔事几何？

rogue_5_relic_custog_4.name: "Tossed Balance"
rogue_5_relic_custog_4.effect: All [Ranged] Operators gain +25% Max HP and +25% ATK
rogue_5_relic_custog_4.flavor: Two talismans joined as one; how much of the old friends' past remains?

src.name: “掷花”
src.effect: 所有【远程】干员部署费用+2，部署时获得2层护盾
src.flavor: 双符相合，故人昔事几何？

rogue_5_relic_custog_5.name: "Tossed Flower"
rogue_5_relic_custog_5.effect: All [Ranged] Operators have +2 DP Cost and gain 2 layers of Shield when deployed
rogue_5_relic_custog_5.flavor: Two talismans joined as one; how much of the old friends' past remains?

src.name: “掷厉”
src.effect: 所有【远程】干员获得抵抗，法术闪避+15%
src.flavor: 双符相合，故人昔事几何？

rogue_5_relic_custog_6.name: "Tossed Ferocity"
rogue_5_relic_custog_6.effect: All [Ranged] Operators gain Resistance and +15% Arts Dodge
rogue_5_relic_custog_6.flavor: Two talismans joined as one; how much of the old friends' past remains?

src.name: “见衡”
src.effect: 敌人进入失衡状态后，防御力，法术抗性-30%，持续10秒
src.flavor: 双符相合，故人昔事几何？

rogue_5_relic_custog_7.name: "Seen Balance"
rogue_5_relic_custog_7.effect: When an enemy becomes Imbalanced, it has -30% DEF and RES for 10 seconds
rogue_5_relic_custog_7.flavor: Two talismans joined as one; how much of the old friends' past remains?

src.name: “见花”
src.effect: 干员每次释放技能时，获得相当于最大生命值10%的屏障，持续10秒（不可叠加）
src.flavor: 双符相合，故人昔事几何？

rogue_5_relic_custog_8.name: "Seen Flower"
rogue_5_relic_custog_8.effect: Each time an Operator uses a skill, they gain a Barrier equal to 10% of their Max HP for 10 seconds (does not stack)
rogue_5_relic_custog_8.flavor: Two talismans joined as one; how much of the old friends' past remains?

src.name: “见厉”
src.effect: 我方干员对【化物】敌人造成的物理和法术伤害提高50%
src.flavor: 双符相合，故人昔事几何？

rogue_5_relic_custog_9.name: "Seen Ferocity"
rogue_5_relic_custog_9.effect: Allied Operators deal +50% Physical and Arts Damage to [Transformed] enemies
rogue_5_relic_custog_9.flavor: Two talismans joined as one; how much of the old friends' past remains?

src.name: 引火兽筝
src.effect: 每次进入岁兽残识时获得1点烛火
src.flavor: 参照巨兽造型设计制作的风筝。飘带用烛火点燃，不灭，也不毁风筝。平日里放飞，在步入岁识时可借其火光，多行一步。

rogue_5_relic_explore_1.name: Fire-Lit Beast Kite
rogue_5_relic_explore_1.effect: Gain 1 Candlelight each time you enter Sui's Remnant Mind
rogue_5_relic_explore_1.flavor: A kite modeled on a colossal beast. Its streamers are lit with candlelight that neither goes out nor burns the kite. Fly it on ordinary days; step into Sui's consciousness, and its glow lets you go one step further.

src.name: 亥食灶
src.effect: 在拾遗节点中有奇妙的作用，完成所有拾遗节点后获得2烛火，最多触发1次
src.flavor: 岁兽残识第十二个时辰入髓后凝聚的实物，形为锅灶。岁兽种种，人间是非，同在一片大地，为何要泾渭分明？

rogue_5_relic_explore_10.name: Hai-Hour Kitchen Stove
rogue_5_relic_explore_10.effect: Has wondrous effects in Gleanings nodes; gain 2 Candlelight after completing all Gleanings nodes (triggers at most once)
rogue_5_relic_explore_10.flavor: An object condensed after the twelfth double-hour of Sui's Remnant Mind sank into the marrow, shaped like a stove. Sui in all its forms, the rights and wrongs of the human world, all share one land. Why must they be kept strictly apart?

src.name: 寅诗壶
src.effect: 希望+2，使当前或下次进入的岁兽残识中部分传说与抉择节点变为可探索状态，在部分传说节点中有奇妙的作用
src.flavor: 岁兽残识第三个时辰入髓后凝聚的实物，形为酒壶。以轶事佐酒，便可见其虚漫的逍遥。

rogue_5_relic_explore_11.name: Yin-Hour Poetry Flask
rogue_5_relic_explore_11.effect: Hope +2; some Legend and Choice nodes in the current or next Sui's Remnant Mind become explorable; has wondrous effects in some Legend nodes
rogue_5_relic_explore_11.flavor: An object condensed after the third double-hour of Sui's Remnant Mind sank into the marrow, shaped like a wine flask. Pair it with anecdotes over wine, and you will see its boundless ease.

src.name: 未建尺
src.effect: 源石锭+6，在故肆节点中有奇妙的作用
src.flavor: 岁兽残识第八个时辰入髓后凝聚的实物，形为量尺。以认知构筑，便可见其滞塞的亲和。

rogue_5_relic_explore_12.name: Wei-Hour Builder's Ruler
rogue_5_relic_explore_12.effect: Originium Ingots +6; has wondrous effects in Old Shop nodes
rogue_5_relic_explore_12.flavor: An object condensed after the eighth double-hour of Sui's Remnant Mind sank into the marrow, shaped like a measuring ruler. Build it with understanding, and you will see its stifled affinity.

src.name: 镇陵哨
src.effect: 本次离开商店时，立即进入岁兽残识并获得3烛火
src.flavor: 镇陵木所做的哨子，吹响后意识便会随着气流一同离体，木哨则会化作柴薪，点燃稳定心神的烛火。

rogue_5_relic_explore_13.name: Mausoleum Guard Whistle
rogue_5_relic_explore_13.effect: When you leave the shop this time, immediately enter Sui's Remnant Mind and gain 3 Candlelight
rogue_5_relic_explore_13.flavor: A whistle made of mausoleum-guarding wood. Blow it and your consciousness leaves your body with the breath, while the whistle turns to firewood and lights a candle that steadies the mind.

src.name: “福祸相依”
src.effect: 钱盒中加入厉钱时，获得1张票券
src.flavor: 如在界园中遇到半行诗，须迅速将此桃木挂饰按压其上。小灾已不可免，然而，祸兮福之所倚。切勿对诗。切勿对诗。切勿对诗。

rogue_5_relic_explore_2.name: "Fortune and Misfortune Entwined"
rogue_5_relic_explore_2.effect: Gain 1 Ticket whenever a Fierce Coin is added to the Coin Box
rogue_5_relic_explore_2.flavor: If you come across half a line of verse in the Garden, press this peachwood charm onto it at once. A small misfortune is unavoidable, but fortune hides within misfortune. Do not finish the couplet. Do not finish the couplet. Do not finish the couplet.

src.name: 家常小炒
src.effect: 所有干员的生命值+20%，攻击力+20%；每通过一场岁兽残识中的战斗，效果额外提升10%
src.flavor: 天为盖，地为锅，嬉笑怒骂，皆为调味。人哪，只要愿意好好吃饭，也就还能好好活着。

rogue_5_relic_explore_3.name: Home-Style Stir-Fry
rogue_5_relic_explore_3.effect: All Operators gain +20% Max HP and +20% ATK; the effect increases by a further 10% for each battle cleared in Sui's Remnant Mind
rogue_5_relic_explore_3.flavor: Heaven for a lid, earth for a wok; laughter and scolding are the seasoning. As long as people are willing to eat properly, they can still live properly.

src.name: 罗德岛应急救援车
src.effect: 希望+2，在岁兽残识战斗时，获得1名随机的罗德岛精英干员支援
src.flavor: 无论你的指令是去往何处——精英干员，使命必达！

rogue_5_relic_explore_4.name: Rhodes Island Emergency Rescue Vehicle
rogue_5_relic_explore_4.effect: Hope +2; during battles in Sui's Remnant Mind, a random Rhodes Island Elite Operator arrives as support
rogue_5_relic_explore_4.flavor: Wherever your orders send them, Elite Operators will see the mission through!

src.name: 木疙瘩
src.effect: 下一次进入岁兽残识时，烛火+2；完成所有岁兽残识中的拾遗和传说节点后，获得10票券
src.flavor: 平平无奇的伥物，据柳儿所说，乃是东海之滨收研的珍物。但除了木质温润，有股提神清香外，似乎并没有什么特别的......

rogue_5_relic_explore_5.name: Wooden Knot
rogue_5_relic_explore_5.effect: Candlelight +2 the next time you enter Sui's Remnant Mind; gain 10 Tickets after completing all Gleanings and Legend nodes in Sui's Remnant Mind
rogue_5_relic_explore_5.flavor: An utterly ordinary Chang object. According to Liu'er, it is a treasure collected from the shores of the Eastern Sea. Yet apart from the warm grain of the wood and a refreshing fragrance, there seems to be nothing special about it...

src.name: 飞驮客运
src.effect: 编队中每有一名【伺烛客】，所有【伺烛客】攻击速度+5（最大叠加10层）
src.flavor: 炎国驰道初开时风靡一时的畜力载具。随着驰道普及，更高速耐久的载具兴起，驰道上飞奔的驮兽身影逐渐消失，随时可能被甩上大道的刺激乘车体验也慢慢被人们遗忘。

rogue_5_relic_explore_6.name: Flying Pack-Beast Coach
rogue_5_relic_explore_6.effect: For each [Candle Attendant] in the squad, all [Candle Attendants] gain +5 ASPD (stacks up to 10 times)
rogue_5_relic_explore_6.flavor: A beast-drawn vehicle all the rage when Yan's highways first opened. As the highways spread and faster, sturdier vehicles rose, the pack beasts racing along them gradually vanished, and with them the thrill of a ride that might fling you onto the road at any moment.

src.name: 子武剑
src.effect: 使当前或下次进入的岁兽残识中所有祸乱节点变为可探索状态，我方所有干员再部署时间-5%，每完成一个祸乱节点叠加1层，最多6层
src.flavor: 岁兽残识第一个时辰入髓后凝聚的实物，形为刀兵。以厮杀洗砺，便可见其锋锐的怒意。

rogue_5_relic_explore_7.name: Zi-Hour Martial Sword
rogue_5_relic_explore_7.effect: All Calamity nodes in the current or next Sui's Remnant Mind become explorable; all allied Operators have -5% Redeployment Time, +1 stack for each Calamity node completed (up to 6 stacks)
rogue_5_relic_explore_7.flavor: An object condensed after the first double-hour of Sui's Remnant Mind sank into the marrow, shaped like a blade. Hone it through slaughter, and you will see its keen fury.

src.name: 午商梭
src.effect: 使当前或下次进入的岁兽残识中所有易与节点变为可探索状态，易与节点中的商品打折，且在任意商店中购买当前所有商品后，该商店下次刷新不消耗票券
src.flavor: 岁兽残识第七个时辰入髓后凝聚的实物，形为织梭。以沟通编织，便可见其层叠的愁思。

rogue_5_relic_explore_8.name: Wu-Hour Merchant Shuttle
rogue_5_relic_explore_8.effect: All Barter nodes in the current or next Sui's Remnant Mind become explorable; goods in Barter nodes are discounted, and after buying all current goods in any shop, that shop's next refresh costs no Tickets
rogue_5_relic_explore_8.flavor: An object condensed after the seventh double-hour of Sui's Remnant Mind sank into the marrow, shaped like a weaving shuttle. Weave it through communication, and you will see its layered sorrows.

src.name: 申铸轮
src.effect: 希望+1，源石锭+3，使当前或下次进入的岁兽残识中所有常乐节点变为可探索状态，在部分常乐节点中有奇妙的作用
src.flavor: 岁兽残识第九个时辰入髓后凝聚的实物，形为铜轮。以好奇煅烧，便可见其脱逸的豁达。

rogue_5_relic_explore_9.name: Shen-Hour Casting Wheel
rogue_5_relic_explore_9.effect: Hope +1, Originium Ingots +3; all Everjoy nodes in the current or next Sui's Remnant Mind become explorable; has wondrous effects in some Everjoy nodes
rogue_5_relic_explore_9.flavor: An object condensed after the ninth double-hour of Sui's Remnant Mind sank into the marrow, shaped like a bronze wheel. Forge it with curiosity, and you will see its free-spirited openness.

src.name: 易锁
src.effect: 在化境地块上随机选择2个可部署位置，每次在该位置部署干员时，获得8点部署费用（在失与得中可以升级）
src.flavor: 易的发明之一，绩用此牟利颇多。既是摆件，又是益智玩具，若能弄清其中奥秘，或许对“岁”的理解能更多一分。

rogue_5_relic_farmer_1.name: Yi's Lock
rogue_5_relic_farmer_1.effect: Randomly selects 2 deployable Realm Tiles; gain 8 DP each time an Operator is deployed on them (can be upgraded at Lost and Found)
rogue_5_relic_farmer_1.flavor: One of Yi's inventions, from which Ji profited handsomely. Both ornament and puzzle; if you can work out its secret, perhaps you will understand "Sui" a little better.

src.name: 错易锁
src.effect: 在化境地块上随机选择5个可部署位置，每次在该位置部署干员时，获得10点部署费用
src.flavor: 经发明者本人改造后的易锁。结构更复杂，嵌套之法似乎变得不循常理。然而，若是能了悟其中的奥秘，或许对“岁”的理解就能更进一步。

rogue_5_relic_farmer_2.name: Twisted Yi's Lock
rogue_5_relic_farmer_2.effect: Randomly selects 5 deployable Realm Tiles; gain 10 DP each time an Operator is deployed on them
rogue_5_relic_farmer_2.flavor: Yi's Lock, reworked by its inventor. The structure is more complex, and its nesting no longer seems to follow any logic. Yet if you can grasp its secret, your understanding of "Sui" may go one step further.

src.name: 母鼎
src.effect: 使所有部署在化境地块上的干员，攻击力+10%（在常乐中有机会升级，上限10次）
src.flavor: 九州万方，自用九鼎以代之。至于这些鼎是怎么铸造的......“当然是母鼎生的啊！”某位电影大师笑着说道。

rogue_5_relic_farmer_3.name: Mother Cauldron
rogue_5_relic_farmer_3.effect: All Operators deployed on Realm Tiles gain +10% ATK (may be upgraded at Everjoy, up to 10 times)
rogue_5_relic_farmer_3.flavor: The Nine Provinces and all their lands are represented by the Nine Cauldrons. As for how those cauldrons were cast... "Born from the Mother Cauldron, of course!" a certain film maestro said with a laugh.

src.name: 嫰竹
src.effect: 使所有部署在化境地块上的干员，生命值+10%（在常乐中有机会升级，上限10次）
src.flavor: 从黍的宝田中种出的新竹，有果无因，循环往复，每循一遭便多一节，直至长出十节，首尾相连。

rogue_5_relic_farmer_4.name: Tender Bamboo
rogue_5_relic_farmer_4.effect: All Operators deployed on Realm Tiles gain +10% Max HP (may be upgraded at Everjoy, up to 10 times)
rogue_5_relic_farmer_4.flavor: New bamboo grown in Shu's treasured fields: fruit without cause, cycling endlessly. With each cycle it grows one more segment, until it has ten, and its end meets its beginning.

src.name: 《围棋入门布局篇》
src.effect: 战斗开始后，随机选择3个可部署的地面化境地块，部署“失修舞台雾机”
src.flavor: 方圆之间，此着为何？棋枰响止，酣畅淋漓。一局终了......时移世易。

rogue_5_relic_farmer_5.name: "Introduction to Go: Openings"
rogue_5_relic_farmer_5.effect: After battle starts, randomly select 3 deployable ground Realm Tiles and deploy a "Disrepaired Stage Fog Machine" on each
rogue_5_relic_farmer_5.flavor: Between square and circle, what move is this? The clack of stones stops; how exhilarating. When the game ends... the times have changed.

src.name: 飞锦战旌
src.effect: 化境地块里的干员释放技能时，给其他所有化境地块里的干员回复1点技力
src.flavor: 传说，曾为结束百氏之乱的那位真龙所用，战旗一挥，百将跟随......强大的从来不是旗帜，而是众人遏战乱、平天下之心。

rogue_5_relic_farmer_6.name: Flying Brocade War Banner
rogue_5_relic_farmer_6.effect: When an Operator on a Realm Tile activates a skill, all Operators on other Realm Tiles recover 1 SP
rogue_5_relic_farmer_6.flavor: Legend says it was wielded by the true dragon who ended the Hundred Clans' Strife; one wave of the banner and a hundred generals followed... The strength never lay in the banner, but in the shared will to halt war and bring peace under heaven.

src.name: 封神令
src.effect: 干员部署在侵入点周围8格时，攻击力+100%
src.flavor: 博物馆收藏的大狩猎时代的征兵令。此令征集一支有能力深入巨兽巢穴的队伍，附在它后面的是签满了名字的生死状。

rogue_5_relic_fight_1.name: Writ of Investiture
rogue_5_relic_fight_1.effect: Operators deployed within the 8 tiles around an Incursion Point gain +100% ATK
rogue_5_relic_fight_1.flavor: A conscription writ from the Age of the Great Hunt, held in a museum. It called for a band able to venture deep into the lairs of colossal beasts; attached behind it is a pledge of life and death, filled with signatures.

src.name: 伥物房账簿
src.effect: 战术道具，召唤物，装置的部署费用减10
src.flavor: 柳儿热情邀请你“试用”伥物房的新发明，你以囊中羞涩为由婉拒，却看到她爽快地在账簿上划拉了几笔。现在，你的理由不成立了。

rogue_5_relic_fight_10.name: Chang Workshop Ledger
rogue_5_relic_fight_10.effect: Tactical Props, Summons, and Devices have -10 DP Cost
rogue_5_relic_fight_10.flavor: Liu'er eagerly invited you to "try out" the Chang Workshop's new inventions. You declined, pleading empty pockets, only to watch her briskly scribble a few lines in the ledger. Now your excuse no longer holds.

src.name: 玩具弹弓
src.effect: 干员释放技能时对攻击范围内的所有敌人造成相当于攻击力30%的法术伤害
src.flavor: 从洪炉中诞生的青铜弹弓，拉开皮筋时，小铜人会蜷成一团沉得惊人的弹丸，以待发射。“喏，拿去玩。危险个锤子，就是个玩具嘛。”

rogue_5_relic_fight_11.name: Toy Slingshot
rogue_5_relic_fight_11.effect: When an Operator activates a skill, deal Arts Damage equal to 30% of their ATK to all enemies within attack range
rogue_5_relic_fight_11.flavor: A bronze slingshot born from the great furnace. Pull back the band and a little bronze figure curls up into an astonishingly heavy pellet, ready to fire. "Here, go play. Dangerous? Nonsense, it's just a toy."

src.name: “成玦”
src.effect: 部署在化境地块上干员，首次被击倒时不撤退且回复30%生命
src.flavor: 界园主人所赠玉佩。园中偶遇良友，一路同行，欲邀你去他处游玩，婉拒后其人嘴脸骤变，强行拉扯你后却如遭烫般缩手逃开。你松口气，发现腰间玉佩已裂了一块。

rogue_5_relic_fight_12.name: "Broken Jade"
rogue_5_relic_fight_12.effect: Operators deployed on Realm Tiles do not retreat the first time they are defeated, and restore 30% HP instead
rogue_5_relic_fight_12.flavor: A jade pendant gifted by the master of the Garden. You met a fine companion in the Garden and traveled together; when you declined his invitation to go elsewhere, his face suddenly changed. He seized you, then snatched his hand back as if burned and fled. Relieved, you found a piece of the pendant at your waist had cracked away.

src.name: 零嘴背篓
src.effect: 战斗开始时所有干员自然回复技力的速度+100%，任意干员手动释放技能时失效
src.flavor: 园林外贩卖的，装满零嘴的背篓，却在入园检查时被扣押。工作人员脸色难看地询问这东西从何而来，你如实回答后，他们一边安慰你没事，一边立刻抄起形状可疑的工具向你说的方向奔去。

rogue_5_relic_fight_13.name: Snack Basket
rogue_5_relic_fight_13.effect: At the start of battle, all Operators' natural SP recovery is +100%; the effect ends when any Operator manually activates a skill
rogue_5_relic_fight_13.flavor: A basket full of snacks sold outside the gardens, confiscated at the entrance check. The staff, looking grim, asked where it came from. When you told them the truth, they reassured you it was fine, then immediately grabbed suspicious-looking tools and ran off in the direction you'd pointed.

src.name: 故履
src.effect: 部署在化境地块上的召唤物，受到的物理法术伤害-50%，攻击力+50%
src.flavor: 桥下拾到的旧草鞋。桥上老者等着你将鞋归还，待上桥，却只看到另一只鞋。仔细想来，老者的面容似在某些古画中出现过......

rogue_5_relic_fight_14.name: Old Sandals
rogue_5_relic_fight_14.effect: Summons deployed on Realm Tiles take -50% Physical and Arts Damage and gain +50% ATK
rogue_5_relic_fight_14.flavor: Old straw sandals found under a bridge. An old man on the bridge waited for you to return them, but once you climbed up, you saw only the other sandal. Thinking back, the old man's face seemed to appear in certain ancient paintings...

src.name: 修习雷针
src.effect: 干员每使用过一次技能，自身的技力自然回复速度+0.4/秒，最多叠加5层
src.flavor: 位于天师府山巅的修习雷法之所。雷法学徒初学引雷之时，都需借助雷针，直至熟能生巧。在天师府别名“前辈”。

rogue_5_relic_fight_15.name: Training Lightning Rod
rogue_5_relic_fight_15.effect: Each time an Operator uses a skill, their natural SP recovery increases by 0.4/s (stacks up to 5 times)
rogue_5_relic_fight_15.flavor: The site for practicing thunder arts atop the Tianshi Academy's mountain. Apprentices learning to call down lightning all rely on the rod until practice makes perfect. At the Academy it's nicknamed "Senior".

src.name: 留春
src.effect: 敌人被击倒时，使其周围所有敌人获得6秒的寒冷
src.flavor: 何家仙人过，聊赠一枝春。

rogue_5_relic_fight_16.name: Lingering Spring
rogue_5_relic_fight_16.effect: When an enemy is defeated, all enemies around it are inflicted with Cold for 6 seconds
rogue_5_relic_fight_16.flavor: An immortal of the He family passed by, and left a sprig of spring as a gift.

src.name: 墙眼
src.effect: 我方干员受到来自自身攻击范围以外的物理与法术伤害降低50%
src.flavor: 它的意识已然存在。它的步伐困于墙中。它为你遮风挡灾。它注视你的远去。

rogue_5_relic_fight_17.name: Eye in the Wall
rogue_5_relic_fight_17.effect: Allied Operators take 50% less Physical and Arts Damage from sources outside their own attack range
rogue_5_relic_fight_17.flavor: Its consciousness already exists. Its steps are trapped within the wall. It shields you from wind and woe. It watches you as you leave.

src.name: 烧火棍
src.effect: 所有干员对【化物】造成伤害时，额外造成一次相当于攻击力50%的法术伤害
src.flavor: 老天师提着这根木棍扫邪魔破巨兽所向披靡。但大多数时候，它都静静靠在厨房一角，只有给炉灶添柴拨火时才会被拿起。

rogue_5_relic_fight_18.name: Fire Poker
rogue_5_relic_fight_18.effect: When any Operator damages a [Transformed] enemy, they deal an additional instance of Arts Damage equal to 50% of their ATK
rogue_5_relic_fight_18.flavor: With this stick the old Tianshi swept away demons and broke colossal beasts, unstoppable. But most of the time it leans quietly in a corner of the kitchen, picked up only to feed the stove and stir the fire.

src.name: 《拳经三问》
src.effect: 干员每使用过一次技能，自身的攻击力+5%，最多叠加40层
src.flavor: 朔的第一本武学笔记，记录了他对拳法的思考。一问拳招，二问拳意，三问武境。据说言语晦涩，学生苦读不懂，他向妹妹请教后又做了改良。

rogue_5_relic_fight_2.name: "Three Questions of the Fist Canon"
rogue_5_relic_fight_2.effect: Each time an Operator uses a skill, they gain +5% ATK (stacks up to 40 times)
rogue_5_relic_fight_2.flavor: Shuo's first martial arts notebook, recording his thoughts on boxing. First, the question of technique; second, the question of intent; third, the question of the martial realm. They say it was so obscure his students couldn't follow it, so he consulted his younger sister and revised it.

src.name: 束伥索
src.effect: 【召唤物】的部署费用-5，再部署时间-25%，攻击力+30%
src.flavor: 被司岁台收编的伥怪在做活时所戴的标记、约束之索。主动倒水的茶壶、努力浇花的花洒，它们十分擅长简单重复的工作。

rogue_5_relic_fight_3.name: Chang-Binding Cord
rogue_5_relic_fight_3.effect: [Summons] have -5 DP Cost, -25% Redeployment Time, and +30% ATK
rogue_5_relic_fight_3.flavor: The marking and restraining cord worn by Chang spirits enlisted by the Sui Office while they work. Teapots that pour themselves, watering cans that diligently tend the flowers: they excel at simple, repetitive work.

src.name: “阿猛”
src.effect: 所有敌方单位受到的元素伤害+100%
src.flavor: 百年前岁兽苏醒的灾祸中，司岁台曾借助经特殊训练的循兽，对伥怪进行全方位的搜索及消灭。此陶制品为纪念当时牺牲的循兽而制。

rogue_5_relic_fight_4.name: "A-Meng"
rogue_5_relic_fight_4.effect: All enemy units take +100% Elemental Damage
rogue_5_relic_fight_4.flavor: During the calamity of Sui's awakening a century ago, the Sui Office relied on specially trained tracker beasts to search out and destroy Chang spirits. This clay figure was made in memory of the beasts that fell.

src.name: 赏善郎
src.effect: 我方单位触发闪避或抵挡后，下次攻击造成的伤害+100%
src.flavor: 天师府学徒自主研制的考校辅助器。答对问题时什么也得不到。答错时......还是别尝试了吧。

rogue_5_relic_fight_5.name: Rewarder of Virtue
rogue_5_relic_fight_5.effect: After an allied unit dodges or blocks a hit, its next attack deals +100% damage
rogue_5_relic_fight_5.flavor: An examination aid built by apprentices of the Tianshi Academy. Answer correctly and you get nothing. Answer wrongly... best not to try.

src.name: 镜中境
src.effect: 敌人首次造成的伤害-90%
src.flavor: 常悬于界园门窗之上的镜子。当游客遇到突如其来的危机，镜中之境便是他们的紧急避难所——直至镜子碎裂。

rogue_5_relic_fight_6.name: Realm in the Mirror
rogue_5_relic_fight_6.effect: The first damage dealt by each enemy is reduced by 90%
rogue_5_relic_fight_6.flavor: Mirrors that hang above the doors and windows of the Garden. When visitors meet sudden danger, the realm within the mirror becomes their emergency shelter, until the mirror shatters.

src.name: 长明灯引
src.effect: 第一名部署的地面干员攻击力+50%、并获得抵抗、50%元素损伤减免，持续至被击倒或撤离
src.flavor: 首次登升之人，为保其心智不被岁识淹没，持燃烛在手。瞢暗迫近，而烛火长明，为其在长夜中锚定意识归来之路。“秉烛”之名亦从中而来。

rogue_5_relic_fight_7.name: Everburning Lamp Wick
rogue_5_relic_fight_7.effect: The first ground Operator deployed gains +50% ATK, Resistance, and 50% Elemental Injury reduction until defeated or retreated
rogue_5_relic_fight_7.flavor: Those who ascend for the first time carry a lit candle, lest their minds drown in Sui's consciousness. Darkness closes in, but the flame burns on, anchoring their way back through the long night. This is where the name "Candlebearer" comes from.

src.name: “萤灯映牍”
src.effect: 敌方单位被击倒时，使周围的我方单位回复300点生命值
src.flavor: 校舍窗边，家乡盆景渐枯，而书生不忍丢弃。终有一日，盆中草不见踪影，而盆上萤火萦绕，替他照亮了书页。

rogue_5_relic_fight_8.name: "Fireflies on the Page"
rogue_5_relic_fight_8.effect: When an enemy unit is defeated, nearby allied units restore 300 HP
rogue_5_relic_fight_8.flavor: By the schoolhouse window, a potted plant from home was withering, but the scholar could not bear to throw it away. One day the grass in the pot was gone, and fireflies circled the pot instead, lighting the pages for him.

src.name: 旦夕墨宝
src.effect: 战斗开始时，随机获得一件仅用于该次战斗的战术道具
src.flavor: 鳞在画卷中游动时吐出的一个又一个泡泡，会带来一些奇异之效。画卷主人不在乎有人擅自触碰它们，反正过不了多久，它们就会破裂，随风消散。

rogue_5_relic_fight_9.name: Ink Treasure of Dawn and Dusk
rogue_5_relic_fight_9.effect: At the start of battle, randomly obtain a Tactical Prop usable only in that battle
rogue_5_relic_fight_9.flavor: The bubbles Lin blows one after another while swimming through the scroll bring strange effects. The scroll's owner doesn't mind people touching them; before long, they burst and scatter on the wind anyway.

src.name: 云与漆
src.effect: 干员部署后60s内，每秒流失2%的最大生命值，让探索开启不同的方向
src.flavor: 人有是非对错，棋有正反黑白，但见得分明与否，巨兽并不在意。就算明谋黑字改换天地，你也仍需得岁意，才可入岁陵。

rogue_5_relic_final_1.name: Cloud and Lacquer
rogue_5_relic_final_1.effect: Operators lose 2% of their Max HP per second for 60s after deployment; leads the expedition in a different direction
rogue_5_relic_final_1.flavor: People have right and wrong; the board has black and white. But whether things are seen clearly or not, the colossal beast does not care. Even if open plots in black ink remake heaven and earth, you still need Sui's consent to enter Sui's Mausoleum.

src.name: 不息
src.effect: 所有敌方单位的攻击力+30％；【伺烛客】及其召唤物在非岁兽残识作战时攻击力、生命值-10％，每进入新的一层，额外-10％。进入“来去处”时，额外-50％
src.flavor: 描绘岁兽时诞生的奇物。即使尚未苏醒，岁兽也不会任由别人翻动祂的记忆与思维，知觉的延伸正在强硬地阻止一切变动。
src.unlock:
【内容拓展 · 二】后，完成
一次游戏结局

rogue_5_relic_final_10.name: Unceasing
rogue_5_relic_final_10.effect: All enemy units gain +30% ATK; [Candle Attendants] and their summons have -10% ATK and Max HP in operations outside Sui's Remnant Mind, a further -10% for each new floor, and an additional -50% upon entering "Laiqu"
rogue_5_relic_final_10.flavor: A strange object born while depicting Sui. Even unawakened, Sui will not let others rifle through Its memories and thoughts; the reach of Its perception forcefully blocks every change.

src.name: 忘生珍珑
src.effect: 干员部署后损失50%的技力值；携带此收藏品时，指点迷津中会出现一场特殊的作战
src.flavor: 一方木料，正面为棋盘，背面则为活字盘，互相倚靠，似无缝隙。活字无法印下内容，只因一枚刻有“吉页”的活字凸出，怎么都摁不下去。

rogue_5_relic_final_2.name: Life-Forgetting Go Puzzle
rogue_5_relic_final_2.effect: Operators lose 50% of their SP after deployment; while you hold this collectible, a special operation appears in Guidance
rogue_5_relic_final_2.flavor: A single block of wood, a Go board on the front and a movable-type tray on the back, leaning on each other as if seamless. The type will not print anything, only because one piece carved with "Jiye" juts out and cannot be pressed down no matter what.

src.name: 隐蝶墨
src.effect: 携带此收藏品时，作战会遭遇“岁躯”的袭击
src.flavor: 柳儿在研究的伥物，采朔之武籍，研岁陵残石而成。本为雕岁乌墨，岁形已逸，以蝶替之，然蝶畏岁威，需驱岁以安蝶。

rogue_5_relic_final_3.name: Hidden Butterfly Ink
rogue_5_relic_final_3.effect: While you hold this collectible, operations will be attacked by "Sui's Body"
rogue_5_relic_final_3.flavor: A Chang object Liu'er is researching, made from Shuo's martial manuals and fragments of stone from Sui's Mausoleum. It was meant to be black ink for carving Sui, but Sui's form escaped, so a butterfly took its place. Yet the butterfly fears Sui's might, and Sui must be driven off to calm it.

src.name: 墨化残碑
src.effect: 战斗开始时，随机选择一名干员，使该干员本场战斗的部署费用变为0，携带此收藏品时，可以在命运所指中让探索开启不同的方向
src.flavor: 蝶驻墨端，“文字”于层层包裹之下显现。失佚的部分已不可明辨，但依字形与偏旁推测，这是一份对于亲属的遥思。

rogue_5_relic_final_4.name: Ink-Stained Stele Fragment
rogue_5_relic_final_4.effect: At the start of battle, a random Operator's DP Cost becomes 0 for that battle; while you hold this collectible, you can lead the expedition in a different direction at Fate's Direction
rogue_5_relic_final_4.flavor: With the butterfly resting on the ink, "writing" emerges from beneath layer upon layer of wrapping. The lost portions can no longer be made out, but judging from the shapes and radicals of the characters, it is a letter of longing for family far away.

src.name: 无封长盒
src.effect: 领袖与精英敌人防御力+30%，攻击速度+20，关卡结束时每有一个仍在场的雕伥，失去1目标生命值（不会低于1），在先行一步中有奇妙的作用
src.flavor: 易流落于岁兽残识中的藏盒。失名失绘，无刻无印。
src.unlock:
【内容拓展 · 一】后，完成
一次游戏结局

rogue_5_relic_final_5.name: Unsealed Long Box
rogue_5_relic_final_5.effect: Leader and Elite enemies have +30% DEF and +20 ASPD; at the end of a stage, lose 1 Life Point for each Carved Chang still on the field (cannot drop below 1); has a wondrous effect in One Step Ahead
rogue_5_relic_final_5.flavor: A storage box that easily drifts into Sui's Remnant Mind. No name, no painting, no carving, no seal.

src.name: 无墨长卷
src.effect: 希望+3，使见字祠中的险路恶敌更加艰难，让探索开启不同的方向
src.flavor: 人与岁兽共同的记忆将藏盒开启，长卷远探，寻找能在这方素白上着墨的往昔。
src.unlock:
【内容拓展 · 一】后，完成

rogue_5_relic_final_6.name: Inkless Long Scroll
rogue_5_relic_final_6.effect: Hope +3; makes the Dreadful Foes in Jianzi Shrine more difficult, leading the expedition in a different direction
rogue_5_relic_final_6.flavor: The shared memories of people and Sui open the box, and the long scroll reaches out to find a past that can put ink upon this blank white.

src.name: 追忆仪
src.effect: 获得时，失去所有的源石锭及希望，并使战斗后获得的指挥等级经验和源石锭-50％。在误入奇境有特殊用处
src.flavor: 由岁兽代理人创造，用以应对岁兽的造物，会在几无尽头的旋转中，剥露出其苏醒的一切可能性以供望提前谋划。
src.unlock:

rogue_5_relic_final_7.name: Reminiscence Device
rogue_5_relic_final_7.effect: On obtaining, lose all Originium Ingots and Hope, and Command EXP and Originium Ingots gained after battles are reduced by 50%; has a special use in Wonderland Astray
rogue_5_relic_final_7.flavor: Created by Sui's proxies to deal with Sui. In nearly endless rotation, it strips bare every possibility of Sui's awakening so that Wang can plan ahead.

src.name: “小磨唧”
src.effect: 费用自然回复速度降低50％，让探索开启不同的方向。在故肆有特殊用处
src.flavor: 被岁兽代理人共同用记忆喂养起来的墨伥，动作不太麻利，却在无数可能性中从旁协助压制岁将醒的意识。
src.unlock:

rogue_5_relic_final_8.name: "Little Grindy"
rogue_5_relic_final_8.effect: Natural DP recovery is reduced by 50%; leads the expedition in a different direction; has a special use at the Old Shop
rogue_5_relic_final_8.flavor: An ink Chang raised on memories fed to it by Sui's proxies together. It isn't very quick on its feet, yet across countless possibilities it helps hold down Sui's stirring consciousness.

src.name: 不赦

src.flavor: 价值连城的瓷杯，背后写有“执此杯者，折桂为居”的字样。听说一共有十二只，某收藏家似乎正好缺这一只。

rogue_5_relic_legacy_120.name: Osmanthus Cup
rogue_5_relic_legacy_120.effect: Hope +4, immediately gain 5 Originium Ingots; when this collectible is exchanged at Lost and Found, gain 1 extra collectible

src.name: 烟烛
src.effect: 为一名未燃烛的干员燃烛
src.flavor: 收集烛堂烟火后制作的灰烛，点燃便会消散，然而在那逝去烟云中所见的往事，将在某人的心中塑成一根不灭的心烛。

rogue_5_relic_legacy_151.name: Smoke Candle
rogue_5_relic_legacy_151.effect: Light a candle for one Operator who has not yet lit one
rogue_5_relic_legacy_151.flavor: A gray candle made from smoke gathered in the Candle Hall; it vanishes once lit. Yet the past glimpsed in that fading cloud of smoke will form an undying candle in someone's heart.

src.name: 惊堂木
src.effect: 钱盒里每有一枚衡钱，所有我方干员生命值+10％（最多+150％）
src.flavor: 据说某位断案的官员常被胡搅蛮缠的犯人气得想砸东西，于是她的弟弟发明了这块木头，既能发泄不满，又能威慑公堂，甚妙。

rogue_5_relic_legacy_152.name: Gavel Block
rogue_5_relic_legacy_152.effect: For each Balance Coin in the Coin Box, all allied Operators gain +10% Max HP (up to +150%)
rogue_5_relic_legacy_152.flavor: They say a certain magistrate was so often infuriated by unreasonable defendants that she wanted to smash things, so her younger brother invented this block of wood. It vents frustration and commands the courtroom at once. Brilliant.

src.name: Blaze的电锯
src.effect: 所有敌方单位受到我方单位伤害时，距离伤害来源越近受到的伤害越高（最高100%）
src.flavor: 她将自己与敌人一同拖入地狱，用炽热来鉴定彼此的决心。她从未失败。

rogue_5_relic_legacy_153.name: Blaze's Chainsaw
rogue_5_relic_legacy_153.effect: When enemy units take damage from allied units, they take more damage the closer they are to the source (up to 100%)
rogue_5_relic_legacy_153.flavor: She drags herself and her enemies down into hell together, testing each other's resolve with blazing heat. She has never lost.

src.name: 手镯轮
src.effect: 我方干员阻挡敌人时，攻击力+50％
src.flavor: 短兵相接，出奇制胜。

rogue_5_relic_legacy_154.name: Bangle Wheel
rogue_5_relic_legacy_154.effect: Allied Operators gain +50% ATK while blocking enemies
rogue_5_relic_legacy_154.flavor: Close quarters, and a surprise strike wins the day.

src.name: 老磨盘
src.effect: 干员受到伤害后，攻击速度+6（最多叠加10次）
src.flavor: 拉磨的兽总挨鞭子，推磨的人总受责骂，结果磨盘是最先崩溃的那个，此后，它但凡听见声响，就会自顾自地转起来。

rogue_5_relic_legacy_155.name: Old Millstone
rogue_5_relic_legacy_155.effect: After taking damage, Operators gain +6 ASPD (stacks up to 10 times)
rogue_5_relic_legacy_155.flavor: The beast that pulled the mill was always whipped, the person who pushed it always scolded, and in the end the millstone was the first to break down. Since then, at the slightest sound, it starts turning all on its own.

src.name: 鸣脊兽
src.effect: 所有我方干员技能未开启时40秒内攻击速度逐渐提升至至高+40，每次技能结束时失去该加成
src.flavor: 这只脊兽负责给整个界园报时，工作人员在它身上花了许多心思，就为了让它快快起飞，一鸣惊园。

rogue_5_relic_legacy_156.name: Chiming Ridge Beast
rogue_5_relic_legacy_156.effect: While their skills are inactive, all allied Operators' ASPD gradually rises over 40 seconds to a maximum of +40; the bonus is lost each time a skill ends
rogue_5_relic_legacy_156.flavor: This ridge beast announces the hours for the whole Garden. The staff put a great deal of thought into it, all so it could take off quickly and astonish the Garden with a single cry.

src.name: 登天斧
src.effect: 所有干员攻击力、生命值+60％。每进入一次岁兽残识，所有干员攻击力、生命值-30％（最多叠加2次）
src.flavor: 曾有樵夫迷失于界园，凭着一把钝斧头和求生欲从山脚一路砍到了见字祠的大门前。之后这位不知岁识为何物的大爷便被“聘”为界园的工作人员，而易则收藏了他再也用不到的斧头。

rogue_5_relic_legacy_157.name: Sky-Climbing Axe
rogue_5_relic_legacy_157.effect: All Operators gain +60% ATK and Max HP; each time you enter Sui's Remnant Mind, all Operators lose 30% ATK and Max HP (stacks up to 2 times)
rogue_5_relic_legacy_157.flavor: A woodcutter once got lost in the Garden and, with a blunt axe and the will to survive, chopped his way from the foot of the mountain right up to the gates of Jianzi Shrine. Afterwards this old man, who had no idea what Sui's consciousness was, was "hired" as Garden staff, and Yi kept the axe he would never need again.

src.name: 虚实线团
src.effect: 干员周围八格内有其他干员时，自身防御力+600，法术抗性+15
src.flavor: 易不知从何处收集来的，绩弃之不用的丝线，在虚线与实线都经过一番处理后，它们被丢入界园一隅，成了野兽们的玩具。

rogue_5_relic_legacy_158.name: Ball of Real and Unreal Thread
rogue_5_relic_legacy_158.effect: While another Operator is within the surrounding 8 tiles, an Operator gains +600 DEF and +15 RES
rogue_5_relic_legacy_158.flavor: Thread Yi gathered from who knows where, which Ji discarded unused. After both the dotted and the solid lines were given a treatment, they were tossed into a corner of the Garden and became toys for the beasts.

src.name: 绸锁
src.effect: 干员周围八格内有其他干员时，自身最大生命值上限+40％
src.flavor: 易为一对老员工证婚时送上的礼物，若是有人变心，这把绸锁就会自己解开——他们已经离开很久了，这把锁似乎仍没有什么变化。

rogue_5_relic_legacy_159.name: Silk Lock
rogue_5_relic_legacy_159.effect: While another Operator is within the surrounding 8 tiles, an Operator gains +40% Max HP
rogue_5_relic_legacy_159.flavor: A gift from Yi when officiating the wedding of two longtime staff members. Should either heart change, the silk lock would undo itself. They left long ago, and the lock still seems unchanged.

src.unlock: 携带不小于3名辅助干员完成一场战斗

rogue_5_relic_legacy_16.unlock: Complete a battle while having at least 3 Supporter Operators

src.name: 循矩残片
src.effect: 干员攻击力+50％，手动开启技能后对应干员失去加成
src.flavor: 矩兽怪异身躯的一部分，如今藏于百灶博物馆。过去，有一组参观过该藏品的游客莫名迈着整齐划一的步伐走出展厅，这件物品随即被运入库房，永不展出。

rogue_5_relic_legacy_160.name: Fragment of the Rule-Keeper
rogue_5_relic_legacy_160.effect: Operators gain +50% ATK; an Operator loses the bonus after manually activating a skill
rogue_5_relic_legacy_160.flavor: Part of the Ju Beast's strange body, now kept in the Baizao Museum. A group of visitors once walked out of the exhibition hall inexplicably marching in perfect step; the item was immediately moved to storage, never to be displayed again.

src.name: 后土残片
src.effect: 位于化境地块上的干员开启技能时，使全场干员攻击力+40％，持续30秒
src.flavor: 后兽沉重身躯的一部分，曾藏于百灶博物馆内。在将整个展馆化作花园后不知所终，或许祂已同这片新生的自然融为一体。

rogue_5_relic_legacy_161.name: Fragment of Houtu
rogue_5_relic_legacy_161.effect: When an Operator on a Realm Tile activates a skill, all Operators on the field gain +40% ATK for 30 seconds
rogue_5_relic_legacy_161.flavor: Part of the Hou Beast's heavy body, once kept in the Baizao Museum. After it turned the entire exhibition hall into a garden, its whereabouts became unknown; perhaps It has merged with this newborn nature.

src.name: 得胜琴
src.effect: 我方干员攻击力+15％。每次损失目标生命值时，攻击力额外+5％（最多叠加17次）
src.flavor: 只有征战归来的勇士才能拨上一个音，一战之后，便得一谱，收为纪念。经历百战，琴体早已被染红。但得胜之音，绕耳不息。

rogue_5_relic_legacy_162.name: Victory Qin
rogue_5_relic_legacy_162.effect: Allied Operators gain +15% ATK; each time a Life Point is lost, gain an additional +5% ATK (stacks up to 17 times)
rogue_5_relic_legacy_162.flavor: Only warriors returning from campaign may pluck a single note; after each battle, a score is earned and kept as a memento. After a hundred battles the qin has long since been stained red, but the sound of victory echoes on and on.

src.name: “万灵方”
src.effect: 干员位于异常状态（寒冷、冰冻、晕眩）时，防御力+1200、法术抗性+30
src.flavor: 研发这药方的小郎中说它只可缓解疼痛，凝神安心，为医生对症下药争取时间。但许多人不疼了就以为是药到病除，便给这帖药安了这么个虚名。

rogue_5_relic_legacy_163.name: "Panacea"
rogue_5_relic_legacy_163.effect: While afflicted by a status effect (Cold, Frozen, Stun), Operators gain +1200 DEF and +30 RES
rogue_5_relic_legacy_163.flavor: The young physician who developed this prescription said it only eases pain and calms the mind, buying time for a doctor to treat the real cause. But many took the absence of pain for a cure, and so gave the remedy this hollow name.

src.name: 醒时塔
src.effect: 醒觉一个岁时
src.flavor: 岁时难抗，但柳儿想了个绝妙的法子。在诸位岁兽代理人的帮助下，她研究出了这座能改换岁时的宝塔。

rogue_5_relic_legacy_164.name: Waking Pagoda
rogue_5_relic_legacy_164.flavor: Sui Hours are hard to resist, but Liu'er came up with a brilliant solution. With the help of Sui's proxies, she devised this pagoda that can change the Sui Hour.

src.name: 承钱盘
src.effect: 投出花钱时，希望+1；投出衡钱时，源石锭+4；投出厉钱时，目标生命值+1
src.flavor: 投钱就要听个叮当响，有好事者为此专门做了个盘子，还美其名曰“一个要摔，一个要挨”。不知不觉间，竟培养出这大地上一等一的识钱好盘。

rogue_5_relic_legacy_165.name: Coin-Catching Plate
rogue_5_relic_legacy_165.effect: Tossing a Flower Coin grants +1 Hope; tossing a Balance Coin grants +4 Originium Ingots; tossing a Fierce Coin grants +1 Life Point
rogue_5_relic_legacy_165.flavor: A coin toss needs a good clink, so some busybody made a plate just for it, grandly calling it "one to throw, one to take the hit". Without anyone noticing, it became the finest coin-judging plate in all the land.

src.name: 小八界贴纸
src.effect: 有概率额外投出通宝
src.flavor: 时常与通宝一起被出售的界园吉祥物贴纸，偶尔会将想要离开藏钱木盒的好朋友们掷出去。

rogue_5_relic_legacy_166.name: Little Bajie Sticker
rogue_5_relic_legacy_166.effect: Chance to toss an additional Tongbao
rogue_5_relic_legacy_166.flavor: Garden mascot stickers often sold together with Tongbao. Now and then they fling out their good friends who want to leave the wooden coin box.

src.name: 兵锋
src.effect: 钱盒里每有一枚衡钱，所有我方干员攻击力+10％（最多+150％）
src.flavor: 每一位禁军都是实力与气运造就的偶然，其兵刃同样如此。

rogue_5_relic_legacy_167.name: Blade's Edge
rogue_5_relic_legacy_167.effect: For each Balance Coin in the Coin Box, all allied Operators gain +10% ATK (up to +150%)
rogue_5_relic_legacy_167.flavor: Every Imperial Guard is a chance product of strength and fortune, and so are their weapons.

src.name: 一串钱伥
src.flavor: 八钱一体，成伥后却各有想法。即使抓住串起它们的线，也并不老实。

rogue_5_relic_legacy_87.name: A String of Coin Chang
rogue_5_relic_legacy_87.flavor: Eight coins as one, yet once they became Chang each had its own ideas. Even if you grab the string holding them together, they won't behave.

src.name: 电弧的掌机
src.effect: 场上每存在一名召唤物，使全体【召唤物】的攻击力+100，防御力+100（最高叠加10层）
src.flavor: 塞入了许多精心制作的小游戏，在游戏主角的身上总能看到电弧日常操控的器械的影子，偏偏没有她自己。

rogue_5_relic_raidian_1.name: Raidian's Handheld Console
rogue_5_relic_raidian_1.effect: For each Summon on the field, all [Summons] gain +100 ATK and +100 DEF (stacks up to 10 times)
rogue_5_relic_raidian_1.flavor: Packed with lovingly made minigames. The game protagonists always carry traces of the devices Raidian operates every day, but never Raidian herself.

src.name: 临渊符
src.effect: 界园中，每层进入的首个战斗节点额外掉落一张随机招募券，可留存的招募券数量+1
src.flavor: 出于对你的信任，司岁台通过了你携带更多干员入园的申请。只不过，溪鳞入陌河，需慎之又慎，这个道理他们希望新来者明白。

rogue_5_relic_res_1.name: Abyss-Edge Talisman
rogue_5_relic_res_1.effect: In the Garden, the first combat node entered on each floor drops an additional random Recruitment Voucher, and the number of Recruitment Vouchers you can keep +1
rogue_5_relic_res_1.flavor: Trusting you, the Sui Office approved your request to bring more Operators into the Garden. Still, when a stream fish enters unknown waters it must be very, very careful; they hope newcomers understand this.

src.name: 三足金雏
src.effect: 获得时随机使持有的以下资源之一翻倍：源石锭、希望、护盾
src.flavor: 异足的祥瑞，听说三只脚分别对应盛衰、生死、兴亡，哪一只脚先落在人身上，其人便可在那方面永享福泽。据司岁台的研究，这生物虽有羽兽的样貌和习性，但恐怕......

rogue_5_relic_res_2.name: Three-Legged Golden Chick
rogue_5_relic_res_2.effect: On obtaining, randomly double one of the following resources you hold: Originium Ingots, Hope, or Objective Shield
rogue_5_relic_res_2.flavor: An auspicious creature with unusual feet. They say its three legs stand for rise and fall, life and death, flourishing and ruin; whichever foot lands on a person first, they will be blessed in that respect forever. According to the Sui Office's research, the creature has the look and habits of a feathered beast, but perhaps...

src.effect: 战斗胜利后有概率使所有我方单位的攻击力和防御力永久+5%（最多叠加10层）

rogue_5_relic_return_17.effect: After winning a battle, there is a chance for all allied units to permanently gain +5% ATK and DEF (stacks up to 10 times)

src.name: 断杖-汲取
src.effect: 所有【术师】干员每对一个单位造成伤害就回复2点技力值
src.flavor: 摄取失败者的养分，踏上恒久的胜利。

rogue_5_relic_return_21.name: Broken Wand - Absorption
rogue_5_relic_return_21.effect: Caster Operators recover 2 SP each time they deal damage to a unit
rogue_5_relic_return_21.flavor: Absorb the nourishment of the defeated, and walk the path of everlasting victory.

src.effect: 所有【重装】干员每2秒束缚自身附近所有敌人1秒，并造成相当于攻击力100%的真实伤害
